name: Necromancer audit: Unrelenting shortens the Crypt Swarm channel by 25% (#943)
contract: Unrelenting 704718 (CharacterAdvancement 11112, class 23) reads 'Reduces the channel time of your Crypt Swarm by $s1%.' Spell.dbc: effect 0 aura 108 (ADD_PCT_MODIFIER) op 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION) and effect 1 aura 108 op 19 (SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME), each BasePoints -26 + DieSides 1 = -25, both with class mask word 0 0x2 in family 29; effect 2 is SPELL_EFFECT_DUMMY, which carries no tooltip mechanic. Crypt Swarm 500965 (family 29, SpellFamilyFlags word 0 0x2) is a channel with SpellDuration 27 = 3000 ms, effect 0 PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE every 1000 ms and effect 2 PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL every 750 ms on the enemy. Native spell mods give the talented caster a 2250 ms channel with 750 ms and 562 ms periods (the same three damage ticks, delivered faster); an untalented caster keeps 3000 ms, 1000 ms and 750 ms. The talented channel must end within 2.6 s of the cast while the untalented one is still running.
